title: tool-families applies the chosen preset to the first request
requirement: A session created under one preset and switched to another before its first message must get the CHOSEN preset's tool-family policy in its first request header, not the creation preset's.
reason: The behaviour needs a running web server, a browser to choose the preset on a blank session, and a real agent turn; the decision logic is covered by scripts/tool-families-proof.mjs (62/62), but the first-request header can only be observed on a live server.
steps: Start a second web server on :3081 with the tool-families scratch row (0.1.8) mounted and the installed row disabled.
Create a new session (it is created under orchestrator) and switch the preset to Backend in the hero before sending anything.
Send any message and read $DSH_HOME/sessions/<slug>/<id>/session.v4.jsonl.zstd: the first request/header tools list.
Expect 67 names, no mcp__playwright__*, bash present.
expected: First request header after switching to backend carries 67 tools, 0 mcp__playwright__*, bash present (the backend row denies playwright; the creation preset orchestrator denies godot/bash). The pre-fix plugin produced 91 tools with 24 mcp__playwright__* on request 1 and 67 on request 2.
